comment: v2.7 patches (after settings-v2.6.json): frame the two shell-added settings rows (字体大小 / 左右边距) in a bordered group so they read as the shell's own block, visually separate from the game's built-in rows (画面质量). Web-only change — hot-updatable, no APK rebuild needed for this part.

patches.find: .set-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .16rem; padding-top: .06rem; }
